description: Add fetch_schedule(date), issuing one request to /schedule?sportId=1&date=<date>, returning {team_id: game_hour_utc}, using gameNumber==1 for doubleheaders and excluding Postponed games.
acceptance_criteria: fetch_schedule(date) issues exactly one HTTP GET to /schedule?sportId=1&date=<date>
Returns a dict {team_id: int} where int is the raw UTC hour (0-23) parsed from that team's game's gameDate
A team with two games that date (doubleHeader) is represented once, using the game where gameNumber == 1
A team whose only game that date has status.detailedState == "Postponed" is absent from the returned dict
A team with no game scheduled that date is absent from the returned dict
steps: Add fetch_schedule(date) to main.py, issuing requests.get to f"{MLB_API_BASE}/schedule" with params {"sportId": 1, "date": date}
Parse the response's dates[0].games list (or [] if dates is empty/absent)
For each game, skip if status.detailedState == "Postponed"; skip if gameNumber != 1

Extract the team id from teams.home.team.id and teams.away.team.id (both teams share the same game, so both get an entry) and the hour from datetime.fromisoformat(gameDate.replace('Z', '+00:00')).hour

description: On a fetch_schedule request failure, degrade gracefully: print to console, append to a plain-text error log, and return an empty dict.
acceptance_criteria: A requests.RequestException raised during the /schedule request is caught inside fetch_schedule; it does not propagate to the caller
On failure, an error message is printed to console (matching the style of the existing per-player connection-error print in scrape_player_data)
On failure, a line is appended to .cache/schedule_fetch_errors.log formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS — <exception message>'; the file is created (with parent dirs) if absent and never truncated
On failure, fetch_schedule returns {} rather than raising
steps: Add a log_schedule_fetch_error(exc, path=SCHEDULE_ERROR_LOG_FILE) helper that mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) on the parent and appends one formatted line
Wrap the fetch_schedule request in try/except requests.RequestException; on exception, print the error, call log_schedule_fetch_error(exc), and return {}

description: scrape_player_data accepts a schedule_map parameter and attaches GameHourUTC to each player's data dict via the crosswalk-resolved team_id.
acceptance_criteria: scrape_player_data(player, url, missing_team_cache=None, schedule_map=None) sets player_data["GameHourUTC"] to schedule_map[team_id] when the crosswalk-resolved team_id is a key in schedule_map
player_data["GameHourUTC"] is None when team_id is unavailable (crosswalk miss or no currentTeam) or not present in schedule_map
No exception is raised in either None case
steps: After resolving team_name/crosswalk_entry, also resolve team_id from crosswalk_entry["id"] when a crosswalk hit occurs
Look up team_id in schedule_map (if both are available) and set player_data["GameHourUTC"] accordingly, defaulting to None

description: compile_player_data accepts and threads schedule_map through to each scrape_player_data call.
acceptance_criteria: compile_player_data(..., schedule_map=None) passes schedule_map through unchanged to every scrape_player_data call
Existing compile_player_data behavior (cooldown skip, no-data cache updates, missing_team_cache updates) is unaffected
steps: Add schedule_map=None parameter to compile_player_data, documented in its docstring alongside the existing cache/missing_team_cache params
Pass schedule_map through to the scrape_player_data(player, url, missing_team_cache, schedule_map) call site

description: __main__ fetches the schedule once per run and passes it into compile_player_data; no persistence of the schedule map across runs.
acceptance_criteria: __main__ calls fetch_schedule(today's date) once before compile_player_data
The resulting schedule_map is passed into compile_player_data
No schedule_map data is written to disk or reused across separate runs
The printed table output (probable_hitters) is unchanged from the current output — no new column, no formatting change
steps: In __main__, compute today's date string and call fetch_schedule(date) before compile_player_data
Pass the returned schedule_map into the compile_player_data(...) call
Confirm probable_hitters and its table.field_names are untouched by this change
